blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, United States—Jensen Huang, the leather-jacketed architect of the artificial intelligence boom, resigned as chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. Chief financial officer Colette Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013 after nearly 25 years at companies including Cisco and Microsoft, will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a successor, ending Huang’s 33 years at the helm of the company he co-founded.
